quarterly_data.quarter: Bristol Myers Squibb press release: U.S. Food and Drug Administration Approves Expanded (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The FDA approved an expanded indication for CAMZYOS (mavacamten) in symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (oHCM) for adults and pediatric patients weighing 30 kg (66 lbs) or more; BMS says it is the only FDA-approved oHCM therapy in a pediatric population and gives CAMZYOS the broadest indication of any cardiac myosin inhibitor. The approval rests on the Phase 3 SCOUT-HCM trial (CAMZYOS n=23 vs placebo n=21, ages 12 to <18), which met its primary endpoint: change in provoked Valsalva LVOT gradient at week 28 of -49.4 mm Hg versus -1.8 mm Hg (difference -48.0, P<0.0001). CAMZYOS has been prescribed by more than 5,000 healthcare providers to over 25,000 patients in the U.S., and the pediatric data are being discussed with multiple global regulators.
